product_metadata.title: Almcmy Floor Scrub Brush,2 in 1 Floor Cleaning Brush with Squeegee,48“ Long Handle Stiff Bristle Bathroom Brush for Tile, Swimming Pool, Deck, Patio, Kitchen, Bathroom
features: 【2 in 1 Cleaning Brush Set】This shower cleaning brush consists of hard bristles and a rubber scraper. After using the brush to clean the grime off the floor, foam and water stains can be easily scraped off with the included scraper. The whole process does not require the use of other additional cleaning tools, and the entire cleaning process is completed efficiently. The 8 cm PET bristles, together with the cleaning agent, can deeply clean the floor and save your cleaning time.

【Handheld Scrub Brush】This floor brush set includes an extra handheld scrub brush with moderately soft and hard bristles, ideal for cleaning sinks, stoves, tiles, and some other crevices and corners that are not suitable for long-handled brushes, grip Comfortable, can be effectively non-slip, small size, suitable for storage.

【Adjustable Long Handle】The floor brush has an iron long handle, the length can be adjusted from 32 inches to 49 inches, suitable for people of different heights. Avoid back pain from prolonged bending and help you clean any hard-to-reach places. It is easy to install and disassemble, and can be hung on the wall when not in use.

【Ergonomic Design】The connection between the cleaning brush head and the handle adopts a 45° labor-saving design, both the hand-held scrub brush and the floor brush have non-slip handles, and the ergonomic handle provides a comfortable grip and protects heavy housework. Easily remove stains, dry and wet, improve cleaning efficiency.

【Wide Use】The floor brush set has built-in durable long bristles, which effectively remove heavy stains, ideal for cleaning floors, walls, sinks, window frames, bathrooms, tiles, decks, kitchens, etc. It can be widely used in tile floors, hardwood floors, Glass surfaces and cement floors.
